related_resources.reason: Hearing Research 47(1-2):103-138. Abstract and methodological descriptions support estimating auditory filters from controlled notched-noise masking experiments; full article may require access.
JASA 109(3):1101-1109, DOI 10.1121/1.1345696. PubMed abstract and bibliographic record; speech experiments, not instruments.
JASA 110(5 Pt 1):2527-2538, DOI 10.1121/1.1408946; three- and four-talker experimental conditions.
Publisher overview of source grouping and scene analysis; full book may require access, so cite the overview only for its stated theoretical framing.
Perception & Psychophysics 23(5):391-398, abstract and Experiment 1. Author-hosted full-text scan; tested repeated ABXY tone patterns, not recorded music mixing.
STFT definition, hop/window/FFT parameters and overlap-add treatment.
JASA 70(4):1003-1014, DOI 10.1121/1.386950. Abstract comparing simultaneous and forward-masking conditions; no DAW-specific recommendation.
JASA 92(6):3102-3108, DOI 10.1121/1.404206. Psychoacoustic frequency-discrimination task, not production-specific time constants.

citation_policy: Source IDs identify the original article/standard/book and the supported claim with locator or abstract scope. Original calculations and teaching examples remain explicitly authored. Anchors must be exact narration substrings; mechanical checks cannot confirm source interpretation.
description: Examines auditory masking and stream formation, showing how instruments compete for attention and how arrangement affects clarity.
